name: University of Bristol
description: The University of Bristol is a public research university in south-west England that received its royal charter in 1909, growing out of University College Bristol (1876). It is a member of the Russell Group.
whyIncluded: The University of Bristol is among the 10 universities in the United Kingdom most chosen by international students (10,900 non-UK students in 2024-25, including 305 from Singapore, per HESA), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The University of Bristol's own average monthly living costs for undergraduates in 2025/26, shown over a 9-month academic year. Excludes tuition, flights and visa costs.
livingCosts.notes: Bristol 'Living costs for students' page, average monthly costs 2025/26, undergraduate column: rent 775.78, utilities 40.64, communications 16.73, groceries 173.85, public transport 34.82, private transport 22.38, medical 10.58, laundry/cleaning 7.69, home entertainment 12.98, dining out 40.43, nights out 49.92, clothing/grooming 28.33, exercise/wellbeing 15.24. Mapped: housing = rent + utilities (816.42); food = groceries + dining out (214.28); transport = public + private (57.20); personal = the rest (141.47). The page headline is GBP 1,401 a month for undergraduates (GBP 1,862 postgraduate); the listed rows sum to about GBP 1,229, so some smaller categories were not itemised in the read. The page does not state how many months it covers; 9 months (UK academic year) assumed.

programmes.name: BEng Mechanical Engineering (H305)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2027 (first-year rate). Bristol reviews fees each year and says international fees rise with expected inflation. No separate compulsory fees.
programmes.notes: Course page for 2027 entry (BEng Mechanical Engineering (H305)): 'International students, £X for the first year. Fees are subject to annual review and are liable to rise each year'; 'international fees increase annually in line with expected inflation rises', so cohortLocked is false. Fee history = Bristol's overseas undergraduate fee tables by academic year and starting cohort (students/support/finances/tuition-fees/ug/overseas/<year>/<cohort>-starters/), row 4MECH010U 'Mechanical Engineering (BEng)': 2026 starters GBP 31,300, 2025 starters GBP 30,400, 2024 starters GBP 29,300. The 2026/27 table also shows 2025 starters' CS fee rising from GBP 32,500 to 33,400 in their second year, confirming yearly increases. No compulsory fees besides tuition.
